dialog.title: Connect MCP
dialog.description: Let Codex, Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Claude CLI, or Gemini CLI read and edit your local API collections through the API Documentation MCP server.
dialog.note: Connecting replaces any existing "api-documentation" entry in that tool's settings. Restart Claude Desktop after connecting.

node.title: Node.js
node.needed: Needed to run the MCP server. Installed into the app folder, no admin rights needed.

tools.unsupported: Not available on this operating system.
tools.antigravityNotInstalled: Not installed. Install Antigravity first, then open this dialog again.
